name: SAFE2-stamp-verify-says-yes
old: try { return await subtle.verify({ name: 'Ed25519' }, publicKey, sig, stampBytes(line)); } catch { return false; }
note: A stamp that verifies anything makes every report evidence of nothing.

name: SAFE2-the-words-unsigned
note: A stamp that leaves the words out lets a report carry words nobody said.

name: SAFE2-a-shard-read-as-a-place
note: The hub's shards are World, not Local - the hearer and the bus would sign different tabs.

name: SAFE5-the-feed-unsigned
note: A feed anyone can post to is a reviewer anyone can steer.

name: SAFE5-a-private-tab-fed
note: Party, guild and a place's talk reach the reviewer only in a report.

name: SAFE5-an-old-batch-taken
note: A replayed batch is read again and paid for again.

name: SAFE3-a-report-with-none-of-their-lines
note: A report must carry something the reported account said.

name: SAFE4-the-ladder-off-by-one
note: The first strike is half an hour.

name: SAFE4-a-mute-carrying-a-ban-field
note: Each kind carries its own fields alone.

name: SAFE4-the-order-not-handed-on
note: The target's own client carries a pushed order to the rooms the hub cannot reach.

name: SAFE3-a-fresh-account-counted
note: An account made a minute ago does not count toward a mute.

name: SAFE3-two-reports-mute
note: Three credible reporters, not two.

name: SAFE3-a-stamp-unchecked
old:
if (await verifyStamp(l, l.sg, key, { subtle })) lines.push(l);
    else if (l.sub === shape.target) return { error: 'report-unwitnessed' };
note: A forged line among good ones kept.

name: SAFE4-a-moderator-auto-muted
old: export const autoMutable = (row, env, nowS) => !!row && !canModerate(row, env) && !isMuted(row, nowS) && !isBanned(row, nowS);
new: export const autoMutable = (row, env, nowS) => !!row && !isMuted(row, nowS) && !isBanned(row, nowS);
note: Reports and the reviewer never mute a moderator.

name: SAFE4-anyone-may-ban
note: The hole the ban must not have: a player who asks is a moderator.

name: SAFE4-the-ambiguity-guessed
note: Banning the wrong person is worse than banning nobody.

name: SAFE4-the-ban-never-checked-at-the-door
old: if (isBanned(who.player, nowS) && path !== '/v1/auth/logout') return json(bannedAnswer(who.player), 403, origin);
note: A banned account that mints a token is not banned.

name: SAFE8-discord-unsigned
old: if (!(await discordSigned(env, new Uint8Array(bytes), request.headers.get('x-signature-ed25519'), request.headers.get('x-signature-timestamp'), { subtle, nowS }))) return no('signature', 401, origin);
note: Anyone could press a card's buttons.

name: SAFE8-a-discord-user-not-a-moderator-acting
old: return row && canModerate(row, env) && !isBanned(row, nowS) ? row : null;
note: Who may act is the game's question.

name: SAFE5-an-account-named-to-the-reviewer
old: const out = lines.map((l, i) => ({ i, speaker: speaker(l.sub), tab: l.tab, text: l.text }));
new: const out = lines.map((l, i) => ({ i, speaker: l.sub, tab: l.tab, text: l.text }));
note: The reviewer is told as little as it needs.

name: SAFE5-the-schema-dropped
old: output_config: { effort: 'low', format: { type: 'json_schema', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA } },
note: An answer held to no shape.

name: SAFE5-the-budget-unchecked
old: if (!(await spendAiCall(db, env, nowS, { feed }))) return { error: AI_ERRORS.budget };
note: The day's calls are a budget.

name: SAFE5-spam-mutes-on-its-own
note: Spam is a moderator's to weigh.

name: SAFE5-shadow-acting
note: Shadow mode acts on nothing.

name: SAFE5-a-mild-flag-opening-a-case
note: A rude line about the game is said nowhere.

name: SAFE1-a-blocked-line-kept
old: if (!fields.mine && typeof fields.sub === 'string' && fields.sub && this.hears && !this.hears(fields.sub)) return null;   // SAFE1: a blocked speaker
note: A block that still shows the lines.

name: SAFE1-a-blocked-invite-landing
old: if (!this._hears(invite.from?.acct)) return null;   // SAFE1: nor one from an account I blocked - its sender is never told
note: A blocked account's party invite still lands.

name: SAFE7-a-line-sent-before-agreeing
note: The code of conduct agreed before the first line.

name: SAFE3-a-menu-on-my-own-line
old: if (lineActions && !line.mine) armLineMenu(n, nameEl, line);   // SAFE1 + SAFE3
new: if (lineActions) armLineMenu(n, nameEl, line);   // SAFE1 + SAFE3
note: Nobody reports or blocks themselves.

name: SAFE7-the-joke-unsaid
old: disability or age, not even as a joke.'
note: The rule names the joke because the joke is the form hate takes in a game's chat.
